name: Landgasthaus Krone
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Landgasthof Krone in Tirol** Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, **Landgasthof Krone** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy, rustic setting. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse offers a perfect retreat for nature lovers and culture enthusiasts alike. **Traditional Tyrolean Cuisine** Indulge in our homemade dishes, where every meal is a celebration of local flavors. Savor the fluffy layers of **Kaiserschmarrn**, melt in your mouth **Apfelstrudel**, or enjoy a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**—each bite tells a story of the region’s rich culinary heritage. **Relax & Unwind** After a day of hiking through the breathtaking **Zillertal** or exploring the historic old town of **Innsbruck**, unwind in our rustic **Stube** with a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** or a warm **Glühwein**. The crackling fireplace and handcrafted wooden furniture create an atmosphere of warmth and comfort. **Adventure Awaits** Whether you’re skiing in the winter wonderland of **Nordkette** or biking along the scenic **Inntal**, our location is your gateway to endless outdoor adventures. For families, the nearby **Alpenzoo Innsbruck** and **Swovobad** offer fun-filled days. **Why Choose Us?** - **Family-run** with over 50 years of tradition - **Homestyle cooking** with fresh, regional ingredients - **Central location**—ideal for exploring **Tirol**’s highlights - **Cozy rooms** with mountain views **Plan Your Stay** Book your escape to **Landgasthof Krone** and let the spirit of **Tirol** captivate you. We look forward to welcoming you! Visit our website | Contact us
